Alice Chen: Brought up fennec-embed-v1 on staging with int6 quant flow. Quick smoke looks off for short queries — recall@1 down 0.62 -> 0.54, recall@5 0.88 -> 0.82. Posting raw outputs and UMAP.
Diego Martinez: Can you paste the eval command + dataset? per-channel or per-tensor quant?
Alice Chen: Eval command I ran: `./eval_embeddings --model fennec-embed-v1 --quant int6 --calib per-channel --dataset shortquery_holdout --metrics recall@1,recall@5,silhouette --seed 42`
Priya Nair: Hmm. Do you have KV cache on? microbatching? Those can change short-query behavior.
Alice Chen: KV cache disabled for the run. Batchsize=8 (default). Silhouette went 0.21 -> 0.14; UMAP shows two intent clusters merged.
Ravi Patel: @Alice can you also run int8 per-channel and float16 baseline for the same dataset? If int8 matches float16 then int6 calibration is suspect.
embed-bot: Automated eval summary for fennec-embed-v1 (run id: run-4743219876)

model: fennec-embed-v1
quant: int6 per-channel
dataset: shortquery_holdout (n=12k)
recall@1: 0.54
recall@5: 0.82
silhouette: 0.14
notes: cluster collapse for intents 'billing' + 'billing_update'

Diego Martinez: If int8 recovers, likely the int6 symmetric quant or clamp range is wrong. Try asymmetric min/max or per-channel bias correction.
Priya Nair: Also try batchsize=1 and batchsize=16 to rule out microbatch accumulation artifacts; run with layernorm folding disabled.
Alice Chen: Running int8 per-channel now + int6 asymmetric cal. Will post results (~15m). UMAP snapshot: http://internal/snap/plots/4743219876/umap.png
embed-bot: Rerun scheduled on dedicated GPU pool (priority), seed=42. Notifying when finished.
Ravi Patel: If this persists in staging, we should push a canary that routes short-query traffic to the quant-int8 variant and keep int6 behind canary. Fallback policy ready?
Diego Martinez: Agreed. I'll add a temporary routing rule in the rollout config. Aim for revert/canary by EOD if we see material customer impact. :chart_with_downwards_trend:
Priya Nair: Good plan. Also capture a few example queries where nearest neighbor changed — helps debug which layers lose signal.
Alice Chen: Adding top-10 mismatches to the run artifact. Will share link when rerun completes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
